title: Fluid grid and interactive chart fallbacks for Console dashboards, rollouts, and cost views
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Scope: Implement a fluid grid system and pragmatic fallbacks for interactive charts and modal behavior across supported browsers for three Console surfaces: Dashboards (overview and per-route cost cards), Rollouts (canary/A-B list and timeline), and Cost Views (token-level breakdowns and charts). Goals: 1) Ensure cards, table columns and chart panels reflow smoothly at narrow widths without horizontal scroll; 2) Provide non-JS or limited-JS visual fallbacks for older Safari/Edge where pointer gestures and high-frequency animation cause jank; 3) Fix modal stacking/focus-trap regressions across Chromium, WebKit, and legacy Edge; 4) Maintain accessibility (keyboard nav, screen reader labels, contrast) and match existing visual language. Not in scope: full redesign of charts or changing backend APIs.

Design approach and trade-offs: We'll adopt a 12-column fluid grid with component-level containment to avoid global layout thrashing. Tables will use responsive column prioritization (collapse low-priority columns into a details drawer on narrow breakpoints) rather than horizontal scroll. Charts will retain interactive features at desktop width; on devices/browsers with known animation pressure (Safari iOS older versions, Edge prior to Chromium switch), charts will degrade to static SVG snapshots with clear CTA to open an interactive detail pane. This trades off some micro-interactions for stable performance and predictable SLOs. Modals: standardize stacking context via a single portal root and explicit z-index tokens; apply focus trap shim and keyboard escape behavior testing to avoid lost focus in nested modals.

Accessibility & internationalization: Ensure that collapsed details are reachable via keyboard, ARIA-expanded/controls are present, chart snapshots include descriptive alt text and accessible summaries for screen readers. Accept long labels and RTL languages in grid tests.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Dashboards and Cost View pages reflow at the following breakpoints: >=1280 (3-column), 960-1279 (2-column), <960 (1-column) without horizontal scrolling; 2) Tables reduce to primary columns + expandable detail row at <720px; 3) On repro browsers (Safari iOS 14, Safari macOS 14, legacy Edge), charts render a static SVG image and the interactive controls are disabled with a tooltip explaining the fallback; 4) Modal focus trap passes manual keyboard testing and automated axe checks; 5) Visual QA checklist completed across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge on desktop and iOS/Android devices; 6) Performance: first meaningful paint for dashboard under simulated throttling remains within 1.5x of baseline or uses the static fallback.

Implementation notes for engineering: Provide CSS variables for grid gutters and card min-heights, prefer CSS grid for large layouts and flexbox for row-level alignment. Where virtualization is necessary for very large tables, use a unified virtualization wrapper to avoid layout jumps. Chart library: create a small wrapper that can swap to snapshot mode by toggling a "data-interactive" attribute. Document required DOM hooks for gating interactivity.
comments: 2026-03-02 - A.Kapoor: Initial concept posted to Figma, included three breakpoint sketches and two fallback patterns for charts. Asked ENG for perf telemetry that pinpoints problematic browsers.

2026-03-04 - L.O'Neill: Reviewed with runtime team. Agreed to expose a 'chartSnapshot' toggle in the Chart SDK and to add a small feature flag for rollout testing. ENG-4297 created for Chart SDK change.

2026-03-06 - Design review: PM (R. Martinez) prefers details-drawer for tables vs horizontal scroll. Accessibility pair (N. Chen) flagged aria-live regions for dynamic cost updates; added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-08 - Prototype v2: added modal portal and focus-trap shim. Manual test on Safari macOS showed stacked-modal focus loss on iOS; created ENG-4332 for modal z-index and focus behavior fixes.

2026-03-10 - QA pass started: visual diffs show minor spacing regressions at 1040px. Decided to increase card min-height variable and tweak gutter scale. Follow-up task assigned to design engineer (ENG-4350).
2026-03-12 - In Review: PM sign-off pending on copy for chart fallback tooltip and rollback policy for the feature flag. Preparing release notes for console-2026.03.
